title: Pet Genie logo
summary: Brand identity for a pet-care app: one brief, three directions, five rounds, one logo the client loved.

steps.heading: The brief
steps.text: Pet parents aged 20 to 40, premium but not cartoony, modern, earthy and fun.

steps.heading: Three directions
steps.text: A friendly genie character, dog-ear lettering, and a dog icon.

steps.heading: The pick
steps.text: The client loved the genie and the lettering with the dog ears, and asked for a mix of both.

steps.heading: Make it simpler
steps.text: Fewer details, same smile, so it works as an app icon.

steps.heading: The best of both
steps.text: The paw from one genie, the ponytail from the other.

steps.heading: Ears, or no ears
steps.text: Two versions: ears when the name stands alone, clean letters beside the genie.

steps.heading: The colour
steps.text: Forest green, mustard, rose and cream, tested across the whole set.
